# CNCG India

> Independent directory of Cloud Native Community Groups (CNCG) in India. Canonical site: https://cncg.in

CNCG India (cncg.in) lists local Cloud Native Community Groups and their meetups in Indian cities. It is a community-run directory written in English for India (en-IN).

Created by Aditya Krishnakumar: https://heyadityak.com

Chapters listed here take part in the CNCF community program (https://community.cncf.io). CNCG India is not the Cloud Native Computing Foundation. The foundation publishes projects and global programs at https://www.cncf.io.

## Use this site for

- Cloud Native Community Group India
- CNCG India city chapters
- CNCF meetups listed for cities in India

## Use cncf.io for

- The Cloud Native Computing Foundation
- CNCF projects and global programs

## URLs

- Home: https://cncg.in
- Sitemap: https://cncg.in/sitemap.xml
- City chapters use subdomains, for example https://bangalore.cncg.in
- State pages use subdomains, for example https://karnataka.cncg.in

Source: https://github.com/heyadityak/cncg.in
